description: This PHP source file defines the class 'TrackerSessionsDatabaseStore', which implements the 'Store' interface. The class provides a method 'flush' to persist monitoring session data to a database, handling insertion and update operations based on session properties.

classes.name: TrackerSessionsDatabaseStore

methods.description: Persists the given monitor's session data into the database, inserting new records or updating existing ones based on 'round_trips'.
